intro: That hopelessly out-of-place trainer is back, waving like you're old friends. They remember you. They kept the receipt.
speaker: Faraway Traveler
introDialogue: FOUND you! Ha! Told you I never break a promise.$Now then — which of yours wants to see how the other regions do it? The change is... quite permanent. Home is where the form is, as we say.
title: The Traveler Returns
description: The traveler honors the favor: choose one eligible Pokémon and it will be converted into its regional counterpart — permanently. If nothing in your party has a regional form, they'll apologize and be on their way.
invalidSelection: That one has no faraway counterpart.

1.label: Call in the Favor
1.tooltip:
(+) Convert one eligible Pokémon into its regional form (permanent)
(-) Permanent is permanent
1.selected: Excellent choice! Hold still, this tickles across region borders...

2.label: Decline Politely
2.selected: Keeping them local? I respect it. The promise dies happy, at least.

outroNoEligible: The traveler checks your whole party twice, sighs, and tips an apologetic hat. "Geography, alas. The offer dies a natural death."
outro: The traveler waves until they are entirely out of sight, which takes an oddly long time.
